lines.en: With her first kiss in the books and her best friend only mildly traumatized, stocks in Tsukasa Tsukioka’s virginity had rapidly soared to a new all-time high.
lines.zh: 初吻已经入账,挚友也只受了点轻伤,月冈月司「童贞」的股价迅速飙升到了历史新高。

lines.en: With estimates showing that it’s still undervalued, though, there was much more time for her to run the share price up before the impending rug-pull when her self-preservational instincts kick in and she realizes that maybe it isn’t best to learn how sex works from an adult male who her own mother informed her was attracted to her.
lines.zh: 不过,估值显示它仍被低估——所以在大崩盘降临之前,她还有大把时间拉抬股价。所谓大崩盘,就是她的自我保护本能觉醒、意识到「从妈妈亲口告知『那个成年男人对自己有性趣』的成年男人那里学习性爱是怎么运作的,也许不是最好的主意」的那一刻。

lines.en: For now, though, she had two things — her overflowing curiosity and an extremely mature and well-informed older sister.
lines.zh: 但眼下,她拥有两样东西——满溢的好奇心,以及一位极其成熟、见识广博的姐姐。

lines.en: And if anyone was going to be able to actually help Tsukasa right now, it would almost assuredly be her.
lines.zh: 而如果此刻真有谁能帮到 Tsukasa,那 almost 必然是她。

lines.en: : Mnh...Tsukasa?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Tsukasa?……

lines.en: : Good morning, Onee-sama. You don’t look scary at all right now.
lines.zh: : 早安,Onee-sama。你现在看起来一点也不吓人。

lines.en: : I can come back at a later time if that is more convenient for you.

lines.zh: : 我只是——

lines.zh: : Lo sé. Sin embargo, tengo una pregunta.

lines.zh: : ¿Qué es?

lines.zh: : 那么,你说过 Jeeves 对我有性趣的判断是准确的、他认为我是他见过最可爱的女孩——

lines.en: : Shh! Tsukasa, that isn’t something you can be saying out loud! What have I told you about speaking with sexual undertones in front of the help?!
lines.zh: : 嘘!Tsukasa,这种话不可以大声说!我叮嘱过你多少次,不许在佣人面前讲带有性意味的话?!

lines.en: : To keep it in the pleasure wing. But none of us ever go there and whenever I try, everybody just walks away and pretends they don’t see me.
lines.zh: : 要讲就去「快乐翼楼」讲。但我们谁都不去那里,而我每次试着去,所有人都扭头走开、假装看不见我。

lines.en: : Well, whatever it is, can it wait until after your lessons? I have to bring Yuki to the doctor’s office this morning and can’t help you right now.
lines.zh: : 好了,不管是什么,能等到下课之后吗?我今天早上要带 Yuki 去医院,现在帮不了你。

lines.en: : I canceled my lessons today because I feel like it’s important for me to practice masturbating, but I can’t figure it out and need help.
lines.zh: : 我今天把课都取消了,因为我觉得练习自慰很重要,但我研究不出来,需要人帮。

lines.en: : Oh. I see. Well, have you asked your sister?
lines.zh: : 哦。这样啊。那你问过你姐姐吗?

lines.en: : Yes, and she shut the door on me after making me stand there for a full minute! Does she not understand how precious my time is?!
lines.zh: : 问了,她罚我干站了整整一分钟,然后把我关在门外!她不明白我的时间有多宝贵吗?!

lines.en: : Have Akira show you, then. It’s not like he ever does anything.
lines.zh: : 那就让 Akira 教你。反正他也从来不干活。

lines.en: : Mother, no! If Jeeves is attracted to me, which he very well should be, it’s important that I maintain a distinguished and civilized guise in his presence!
lines.zh: : 妈妈,不行!如果 Jeeves 对我有性趣——他 very well 应该有——那我就必须在他面前维持高贵、文明的仪态!

lines.en: : I worry that may make him like you less, dear.
lines.zh: : 我担心那样反而会让他不那么喜欢你,亲爱的。

lines.en: : If this is truly urgent, surely there’s someone else you know who could help you with it?
lines.zh: : 如果这事真的很急, Surely 你认识的其他人里,总有一个能帮你吧?

lines.zh: : 可我几乎谁都不认识。

lines.zh: : 亲爱的,你是月冈家的人。 Surely 会有人。

lines.en: Needless to say, things weren’t going all that well for Tsukasa this morning. It was barely 9:00 AM and she had already asked three people about masturbation and ridden on a train. Twice.
lines.zh: : 不必说,这天早上 Tsukasa 的进展并不顺利。才刚过早上九点,她已经问了三个人关于自慰的事,还坐了两趟电车。

lines.en: So now, here she was — back in her room to try her hand (pun unintended) at self-pleasure once more. Just this time, she’d be doing it with an audience.
lines.zh: : 于是现在,她回到了自己的房间,再一次尝试亲手(谐音纯属巧合)取悦自己。只是这一次,她有一群观众。

lines.en: : Okay! Listen up, you pathetic inbred whelps.
lines.zh: : 好!都听好了,你们这些可怜的、近亲繁殖的小崽子。

lines.en: : There comes a time in every little girl’s life where she must grow up. She must become a woman. And, despite what Chinami or anybody else may have told you, that time for me is now.
lines.zh: : 每个小女孩的一生中,都会迎来成长的时刻。她必须成为女人。而且,不管 Chinami 或其他任何人跟你们说过什么,我的这个时刻,就是现在。

lines.en: : So what we’re going to do, as a team, is decide which one of you gets to have sexual intercourse with me. Understood?
lines.zh: : 所以,作为一个团队,我们要决定的是:你们当中谁有幸与我性交。明白了吗?

lines.en: : Now, the first order of business is- wait a second! What happened to Super Sonic Jalapeno Meltdown Catastrophe Nine?! Trixie?! You were supposed to be keeping an eye on him!
lines.zh: : 现在,第一项议程——等一下!超级音速辣椒熔毁灾难九号去哪了?!Trixie?!说好了你盯着他的!

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Tsukasa! I tried to- NO EXCUSES! As the senior most member of the Plush-pal Armada, it is your responsibility to make sure everyone shows up on time.
lines.zh: : 对不起,Tsukasa!我试着——不许找借口!作为玩偶舰队资历最老的成员,确保全员准时到场是你的责任。

lines.en: : So, as punishment for your actions, you will not be chosen to have sexual intercourse with me today. Which works out because you are also a girl and I think I need to try a boy for stuff this time.
lines.zh: : 所以,作为对你失职的惩罚,今天你落选了,没资格和我性交。这样也好,因为你也是女孩,而我觉得这次我该试试男孩。

lines.en: : Which means it comes down to either Tank, Glockenspiel, Cantaloupe, or Steve. I will now hear your cases. Please keep them as concise and professional as possible.
lines.zh: : 也就是说,候选只剩 Tank、Glockenspiel、Cantaloupe 或 Steve。现在,请陈述你们的理由。请务必简洁、专业。

lines.en: : I’m unworthy, princess Tsukasa! There’s nothing I could possible say to make you choose me! Right you are, Tank! But your honesty is admirable, so I’ll think about it.
lines.zh: : 我不配,月司公主!我说什么都配不上你的选择!说得对,Tank!但你的诚实值得嘉奖,我会考虑的。

lines.en: : I know I’m the smallest, but size isn’t everything! After all, you’re- SILENCE!
lines.zh: : 我知道我是最小的,但尺寸不代表一切!毕竟你——住口!

lines.en: : If you understood anything about my potential suitors, you’d understand that they’re all going to be bigger than me! Which means any PIPSQUEAKS like you are out of the question! Next!
lines.zh: : 你要是了解我的潜在追求者,就该明白他们都比我大!所以像你这种小不点出局!下一个!

lines.en: : Cantaloupe HATES the Jews!
lines.zh: : Cantaloupe 仇恨犹太人!

lines.en: : CANTALOUPE! Go wash your mouth out with soap right this instant! Antisemitism will NOT be tolerated in this household!
lines.zh: : CANTALOUPE!立刻去用肥皂洗嘴!反犹主义在这个家庭绝不容忍!

lines.en: : That leaves just you, Steve. What do you have to say for yourself? Why should I choose you over Tank or Pipsqueak? I mean Glockenspiel.
lines.zh: : 那就只剩你了,Steve。你有什么要为自己辩解的?我为什么该选你而不是 Tank 或小不点?我是说 Glockenspiel。

lines.en: : Because dragons have been around since the dawn of time! Which means I have far more experience than somebody like Tank could ever have as a weird red alien guy. Oh yeah? You have experience? With who?
lines.zh: : 因为龙自创世以来就存在!这意味着我的经验远超 Tank 那种奇怪的红皮肤外星人。是吗?你有经验?跟谁?

lines.en: : I served in King Arthur’s ninth battalion and managed his own personal brothel in which I tested the merchandise for- AHAH! Referring to women as merchandise?! Unacceptable!
lines.zh: : 我在亚瑟王的第九营服役,还管理过他私人的妓馆,在里面检验商品……啊哈!把女性称作商品?!不可接受!

lines.en: : Which I guess leaves you, Tank. Congratulations on eking out a victory simply because you acknowledged how far out of your league I am. What’s about to happen is a privilege. Do not forget that.
lines.zh: : 我猜,那就只剩你了,Tank。恭喜你勉力获胜——就因为你承认了「你配不上我」。接下来发生的事,是一种特权。别忘了这点。

lines.en: : The question now is exactly how we’re going to do this, though. They don’t make plushes with penises attached to them. At least as far as I know. So we’ll just have to imagine you have one, I guess.

lines.en: : I’m sorry in advance if I hurt you. But I suppose doing so will make it easier to accept it when the time comes for me to be on the other end of such a large size differential. And that time is coming soon, Tank.
lines.zh: : 如果我弄疼你,先道歉。不过我猜,提前练习一下,等到轮到我面对这么大尺寸差的时候,会更容易接受。那一天快来了,Tank。

lines.en: : I told you what Mother said about Jeeves, right? How he can’t keep his eyes off of me and has been drowning in temptation this whole time? I knew it! Just imagine if Cantaloupe had that level of restraint.
lines.zh: : 我告诉过你妈妈是怎么说 Jeeves 的吧?说他没办法把眼睛从我身上挪开、一直在欲海里挣扎?我就知道!想象一下,要是 Cantaloupe 有那种自制力会怎样。

lines.en: : Anyway, lie down like that while I get on top of you and try to figure this out. Apparently, this method works well for other girls who can’t “get off” by using their fingers.
lines.zh: : 总之,保持那个姿势躺好,我骑到你身上,试着研究一下。据说,这个方法对那些用手指「到不了」的女孩很有效。

lines.en: : I think there are adult toys too, but I tried looking them up and none of them seem very fun. You don’t mind if I wear my underwear right? It seems unsanitary not to.
lines.zh: : 我想还有成人玩具,但我查了一下,看起来都没什么意思。我穿着内裤你不介意吧?不穿似乎不卫生。

lines.en: : Yes, princess Tsukasa! Any amount of attention from you at all is- um...

lines.en: Share prices continue to soar as the young girl experimentally grinds herself against a plush toy she’d owned since long before these thoughts ever assailed her.

lines.en: And while it didn’t feel much like anything yet, it’s not like it felt bad either. Just awkward. She couldn’t help but keep her eyes open. Or feel like she was violating some sort of sacred bond between girl and alien.
lines.zh: : 虽然暂时没什么感觉,但也不难受。只是别扭。她忍不住睁着眼睛。也忍不住觉得自己正在侵犯某种「女孩与外星人」之间的神圣羁绊。

lines.en: But when she closed her eyes, and imagined someone else there, someone who I’m sure you’re already thinking of as well — that’s when the feelings hit.
lines.zh: : 可当她闭上眼、想象那里有另一个人——一个我确信你此刻也在想的人——感觉才轰然降临。

lines.en: It was something she couldn’t do when she was experimenting with her fingers. But, having spent so long ascribing personalities to the cotton crowd who looked on at her cowgirl tryouts made it seem more real.
lines.zh: : 这件事她用手指试验时做不到。但她在棉花园里给围观她「女牛仔式试骑」的观众们赋予了太久的性格,让这一切显得更真实了。

lines.en: Her movements became more passionate as she dragged herself harder against the toy, focusing mainly on a single button on its belly that felt good when it clipped her just right. So she kept doing that.
lines.zh: : 她的动作越来越热烈,把自己往玩偶上磨得更狠,焦点集中在它肚子上的一颗纽扣——它恰好卡在某个角度时,感觉很好。于是她一直那样磨。

lines.en: So much so, in fact, that she ultimately tore the button clean off and was left frantically searching for something else that could make her feel good again.
lines.zh: : 磨到什么程度呢——她最终把那颗纽扣整个扯了下来,然后疯狂寻找别的东西,想找回那种舒服的感觉。

lines.en: That’s when it finally hit. That instinctual urge to fill a certain void within her. That sinking feeling that she’d feel more full with a true partner. With a specific partner. With Jeeves.
lines.zh: : 就在那时,它终于降临。那种本能的冲动,想填满体内某处空洞的冲动。那种下沉的感觉:如果有一个真正的伴侣,她会更「满」。一个特定的伴侣。Jeeves。

lines.en: The tone shifts entirely. She likes it. This is real. It all suddenly makes sense.
lines.zh: : 语调彻底转变。她喜欢。这是真的。一切突然都说得通了。

lines.en: But also it doesn’t. Yet it does. And it doesn’t and does and doesn’t and does but she can’t explain it and can’t think of anything but the button and his face and his button and the void within her, desperate to be treated like a REAL princess but also CLAIMED like property!
lines.zh: : 但同时又说不通。可又说通了。说不通又说通又说不通又说通,而她解释不了,满脑子除了那颗纽扣、他的脸、他的纽扣、她体内的空洞之外,什么都容不下——她渴望被当作真正的公主对待,又渴望像财产一样被「认领」!

lines.en: Like SHE was claiming something now! In control in the most carnal way possible, yet reversing roles internally while different systems deeper down had her firing on all cylinders at the thought of even DEEPER systems.
lines.zh: : 就像此刻「她」在认领某样东西!以最肉欲的方式掌控一切,而在内部却又角色互换;更深处不同的系统,让她一想到「更深层的系统」就全线开火。

lines.en: The kind that cause insanity and screaming and all of THAT made sense now too since if THIS felt THAT good then HOW would it feel once THE VOID HAS BEEN FILLED?

lines.en: : Haaah!
lines.zh: : 哈啊!

lines.en: She thought of Chika. Not intentionally. But it was a thought that came up.
lines.zh: : 她想到了 Chika。并非刻意。但那个念头就是冒了出来。

lines.en: Of the noises that cool older girl made through the walls as she and Chinami listened in confused but also not because she gets it now but it’s STILL kind of confusing since this is ALL confusing.
lines.zh: : 想到那个很酷的姐姐隔墙发出的声音,她和 Chinami 一边困惑地偷听、一边又不困惑——因为她现在懂了,但这「仍然」让人困惑,因为一切「全都」让人困惑。

lines.en: Then she thought of the teacher. The other one. How she, too, had fallen victim to the pleasures of the flesh just feet away from where Tsukasa was now.
lines.zh: : 然后她想到了老师。另一位老师。想到她,也在离 Tsukasa 此刻几步之遥的地方,沦为肉体欢愉的猎物。

lines.en: She could see it. Smell it. What was that? So intoxicating and terrifying all at once.
lines.zh: : 她能看见。能闻到。那是什么?如此令人迷醉,又如此令人恐惧。

lines.en: She thought of everyone. Everything. And for a moment, the world had spiraled into utter chaos where NO thought would stick for more than just a second or two. What was happening to her? Was she broken?
lines.zh: : 她想到了所有人。所有事。有那么一瞬间,整个世界旋转成彻底的混乱,「没有任何」念头能停留超过一两秒。她这是怎么了?她坏掉了吗?

lines.en: : Aaah! That...aah...aaaaah!
lines.zh: : 啊!那个……啊……啊啊!

lines.en: She was broken. She was definitely broken. Something was breaking. Something was going to break. But she wanted to break it. Snap it. Destroy it. KILL IT. She just needed to PUSH. HARDER. DEEPER. SHE’S RIGHT THERE. She’s GROWING UP.
lines.zh: : 她坏掉了。她绝对坏掉了。有什么东西正在碎裂。有什么东西即将碎裂。但她想亲手打碎它。折断它。毁灭它。杀死它。她只需要再用力。更用力。更深。她就在那里。她正在「长大」。

lines.en: : I can’t...I...aaaah...
lines.zh: : 我不能……我……啊啊……

lines.en: Then she suddenly stops. After just a few seconds in the first of seven rings of ecstasy.
lines.zh: : 然后她突然停下。才在七重狂喜的第一圈里待了几秒钟。

lines.en: Because, despite having rarely been told “no” in her life, what she was doing now felt like something she wasn’t allowed to do. Like it was wrong, but she couldn’t explain why.
lines.zh: : 因为,尽管她这辈子很少听到「不」,她此刻做的事,却让她感觉像一件「不被允许」的事。像一件错事,而她说不出为什么。

lines.en: So she laid there for a few minutes. Feeling guilty. Feeling gross. Feeling strangely and uncomfortably wet. Pressing her thighs together because, weirdly enough, that felt kind of good too but not the kind that made her want to explode.
lines.zh: : 于是她躺了几分钟。感觉内疚。感觉恶心。感觉一种奇怪又难受的湿。并拢双腿——因为奇怪的是,那样也好受一点,却不是那种让她想爆炸的好受。

lines.en: She couldn’t bring herself to look at Tank, but knew that he was staring directly at her — furious that she would so violently tear a piece of him off for good in the throes of fiery, curious passion.
lines.zh: : 她不敢看 Tank,但她知道他正直直盯着她——愤怒于她竟在炽热、好奇的激情中,永远地扯走了他身上的一块。

lines.en: It was something Tsukasa would inevitably feel soon enough as well.

lines.en: Even sooner than one might think.

lines.en: The phone felt colossal in her hand. But it would be nothing compared to what she’d feel like in his.
lines.zh: : 手机在她手里像一座巨物。但比起待在他手里时的感觉,这不算什么。

lines.en: She thumbs the name she gave him like he’s some sort of pet. But it’s less because she thinks of him that way and more because she fears that his actual name would make the strange, uncomfortable wetness worse.
lines.zh: : 她用拇指摩挲着给他起的名字,像他是一只宠物。但这与其说是她那样看待他,不如说她害怕——如果打出他的真名,那股奇怪又难受的湿,会更糟。

lines.en: The stares of her inanimate friends apply a level of peer pressure she could not experience anywhere else and beckon her to KILL.
lines.zh: : 那些无生命的朋友们的注视,施加着一种她在别处体验不到的同辈压力,引诱着她去「杀戮」。

lines.en: But before one does so, they must have a plan when it comes to burying a body.
lines.zh: : 但在动手之前,必须先有埋葬一具身体的计划。

lines.en: They must prepare for the consequences of their temporary high- or the unfortunate falling actions that can only come from the most monumental of climaxes.
lines.zh: : 他们必须为短暂的快感过后的后果做好准备——或者那些只能源自最宏伟的高潮、不幸的「坠落动作」。

lines.en: With the gun in her hand, she fingers the trigger, aiming the barrel directly at the head of a sleeping giraffe.
lines.zh: : 枪已在手,她的手指拨着扳机,枪口对准一只熟睡的长颈鹿的头。

lines.en: But giraffes sleep standing up.
lines.zh: : 但长颈鹿是站着睡觉的。

lines.en: She is biting off more than she can chew.
lines.zh: : 她咬下的东西,超出了她能咀嚼的范围。

lines.en: Tsukasa’s lust has increased to [tsukasa_lust]!
lines.zh: Tsukasa 的欲望提升到了 [tsukasa_lust]!
